title: Bilevel MPC for Linear Systems: A Tractable Reduction and Continuous Connection to Hierarchical MPC
summary: Model predictive control (MPC) has been widely used in many fields, often in hierarchical architectures that combine controllers and decision-making layers at different levels. However, when such architectures are cast as bilevel optimization problems, standard KKT-based reformulations often introduce nonconvex and potentially nonsmooth structures that are undesirable for real-time verifiable control. In this paper, we study a bilevel MPC architecture composed of (i) an upper layer that selects the reference sequence and (ii) a lower-level linear MPC that tracks such reference sequence. We…
